subject: Sponsorship playbook — logo sizing, onstage brief, exec roundtable slot
messages:
From: Heather Jones <heather.jones@eventworks.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: sponsorship@eventworks.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Updated playbook + exec roundtable slot — need assets and onstage brief

Hi Olga & Ben,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a Premier sponsor for CloudCon Q4. Attached is the updated sponsor playbook with final logo placements and the speaking grid. A few open items we need from you to finalize signage and stage sequencing: 

- High-res logos (SVG preferred) for Primary and Secondary placements
- Preferred 30-minute onstage brief title and 3-bullet synopsis
- Exec roundtable panelist name for the Thursday 11:30AM slot (we have a 45-minute slot)

I also attached the stage elevation diagram — we’ll need any A/V notes (lapel vs. handheld) and whether you want a mic check prior to the session.

I’ve included a tentative DocuSign link for the final addendum; please let me know if your procurement needs a PO first.

[Attachment: sponsor_playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 410KB)]
[Attachment: stage_elevation.png (PNG, 220KB)]

Best,
Heather
Heather Jones
Director, Sponsorships — EventWorks
heather.jones@eventworks.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Heather Jones <heather.jones@eventworks.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated playbook + exec roundtable slot — need assets and onstage brief

Hi Heather,

Thanks for the playbook — received. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Logo assets: uploading primary and alt logos to the Drive folder now (redwood_logo_primary.svg, logo-guidelines.png). Please confirm file naming and exact placement on the 10x20 lanyard banner; we’d prefer Primary on center-right and Secondary on booth skirt.
- Onstage brief: Olga Petrov (Head of Partnerships) will present. Title: “Serving Deterministic LLMs at Scale.” Synopsis (for program): 30 min — a short overview of serving runtime optimizations, followed by a 10 min live demo of latency/cost dashboards and a 10 min Q&A.
- Exec roundtable: We’d like to seat Samir Patel (VP Product, JupiterCloud) as our guest panelist — he has overlap with several customers attending. Can you confirm that external guests are permitted and whether we should submit a short bio?

A/V notes: lapel preferred; we’ll bring a small demo laptop but request HDMI + USB-C video and a 10-min soundcheck window.

Procurement: we can sign via DocuSign. If you need a PO, procurement can produce one within 48 hours after DocuSign is out.

[Drive link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/eventworks-sponsor-assets]

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa on logo placement and brand usage.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Heather Jones <heather.jones@eventworks.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: sponsorship@eventworks.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Updated playbook + exec roundtable slot — need assets and onstage brief

Hi Olga — perfect, thanks for the details. A few clarifications: 

- External guests: allowed, but we need a short bio + headshot for Samir for the roundtable program. Please submit by Thursday 7/2 so we can finalize the printed guide.
- Lanyard/booth: center-right for Primary is fine — we’ll update the mock.
- DocuSign: I’ve prepared the addendum and will send the DocuSign envelope this afternoon; you can sign and return. If procurement still needs a PO, we’ll accept the signed addendum and then take a PO after if that works.

Also, we can schedule a 10-minute mic check at 9:40AM on the session day — will that slot work?

Heather
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsorship playbook — logo sizing, onstage brief, exec roundtable slot

Quick notes from marketing: 

- Logo sizing: primary logo min width 180px for digital; for print we need vector with 0.25 in bleed. I uploaded a scaled PNG samples file to the Drive folder (logo-guidelines.png).
- Please confirm whether we want the alternate stacked mark on the stage backdrop — stacked reads better on tall scrims. If yes, I approve stacked for backdrop only; keep horizontal for booth and lanyard.
- Branded collateral: we’ll prepare 200 one-sheets (two-sided) and need the two-sentence product blurb. Olga, can you give us the blurb by EOD Wednesday?

Ben — coordinate with Ops for shipping labels and confirm booth install window (we have 4 hours on set-up day).

Marissa
VP, Product Marketing — Redwood Inference
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Heather Jones <heather.jones@eventworks.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsorship playbook — logo sizing, onstage brief, exec roundtable slot

Heather — thanks, all good on our end. Final checklist and deliverables: 

- I uploaded Samir’s bio + headshot to the Drive link (Samir Patel — VP Product, JupiterCloud). He’s confirmed availability for the 11:30AM Thursday roundtable.
- Brand assets uploaded: redwood_logo_primary.svg, logo-guidelines.png, redwood_one_sheet_v1.pdf (for Marissa).
- Olga’s session title & 3-bullet synopsis (see earlier) — please reserve a 30-min timeslot with a 10-min Q&A buffer.
- Mic check scheduled for 9:40AM on session day; HDMI + USB-C confirmed.
- DocuSign: I’ll sign this afternoon. If procurement needs a PO afterward I’ll route it through Finance (deal id DW-2026-087).

Look forward to final mocks. If you need any additional creative sizes for the stage backdrop let us know by noon Friday.

Best,
Olga
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
